gloss: to leave over; to leave (something) remaining; to have to spare

definitions.gloss: to leave (something) over; to leave remaining
definitions.explanation: To leave a portion of something unused, unfinished, or unconsumed. The transitive counterpart of {余|あま}る.
Used in fixed expressions like {〜|〜}を{余|あま}して to mean 'with (time/distance) to spare' before reaching a deadline or destination.

examples.japanese: ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{余|あま}した。
examples.english: I left some rice over (didn't finish it).

examples.japanese: ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{余|あま}して⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
examples.english: He won with energy to spare.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧{余|あま}して⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着|つ}いた→着く：00680_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: I arrived at the station with plenty of time to spare.

examples.japanese: ⟦おかず→おかず：08272_okazu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{余|あま}して⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}して→残す：01975_nokosu⟧おいた。
examples.english: I left a bit of the side dish over and saved it for my younger brother.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{一|いち}{時間|じかん}→一時間：00941_ichijikan⟧{余|あま}して⟦{原稿|げんこう}→原稿：00064_genkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}き{上|あ}げた→書き上げる：06978_kakiageru⟧。
examples.english: He finished writing the manuscript with an hour to spare before the deadline.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧きれず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{余|あま}してしまった。
examples.english: I couldn't finish it and ended up leaving half the food over.
examples.notes: {〜|〜}してしまう adds the nuance of regret or unintended outcome.

notes:
{余|あま}す is the transitive counterpart of ⟦{余|あま}る→余る：00001_amaru⟧ (to be left over). The pair forms a classic transitive/intransitive set: someone {余|あま}す something, vs. something ⟦{余|あま}る→余る：00001_amaru⟧ on its own.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive: ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{余|あま}す (to leave rice over) — the speaker actively leaves it
- Intransitive: ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{余|あま}る→余る：00001_amaru⟧ (the rice is left over) — it simply remains

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{余|あま}す: to have time to spare
- ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{余|あま}す: to have energy/strength to spare
- {〜|〜}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{〜|〜}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧{余|あま}して: with (number of) hours to spare
- {持|も}て{余|あま}す: to be unable to handle (a separate fixed compound — see related)

USAGE:
- Sense 1 (leaving food/material over) is much less common in everyday speech than ⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧, which is the default verb for leaving food on a plate. {余|あま}す sounds slightly stiff or literary in this sense.
- Sense 2 (⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{余|あま}して, etc.) is the more frequently encountered pattern, especially in sports commentary and news.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{余|あま}る→余る：00001_amaru⟧: intransitive counterpart — to be left over
- ⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧: to leave behind (more common for food/items)
- {持|も}て{余|あま}す: to be at a loss with; to find too much to handle
